name: CR-Diff-02-linearity-3.c
questiontext:
Expand the powers and find the following derivative:
 \[ \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}\left[\left({{CT:1}}\right)^{{CT:2}}\right] . \]

 [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
In order to solve this problem we will have to use the linearity rules for differentition. <hint>calc_diff_linearity_rule</hint>

 \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
   \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}\left[\left({{CT:1}}\right)^{{CT:2}}\right] &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}\left( {{CT:3}}\right) \\
    &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:4}}\cdot \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}({{CT:5}}) \\
    &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:4}}\cdot {{CT:6}} \\
    &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:7}}
  \end{array}\]
